items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: I says, “Freddie, I want you to meet Mike Scott.”

ctx.x: Thad Jones was the leader of the band. I hate to forget names, but just people I associate with. Something humorous to me personally was when Freddie Green had the band and at intermission I went up to Freddie and I says, “Freddie, I want you to meet Mike Scott.” I says, “I’ve got three of them in the band” meaning three brothers. They are three black cats I had in the band. And Freddie thought I meant I had three black cats in the band, and that I was trying to be—
